name: Paddock API — 60 requests per minute per IP
notes: Counts API routes and the direct /api/index.py entry point; excludes static assets.
Vercel counts per region, not a single global counter across every region.
Hobby documentation: one rate limit rule/project within three custom rules; 1,000,000 allowed requests included.
Does not establish a shared-team CPU/memory/spending cap or guaranteed availability.
